patch.summary: Bouncer implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Bouncer by mapping current email-marketing workflows to Bouncer objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Activecampaign) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Mailchimp

blocks.heading: Bouncer day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Bouncer setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Marketers cleaning lists before campaigns before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Mailchimp and HubSpot before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not an email sending or campaign tool
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not an email sending or campaign tool

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Core verification is credit-based (not a single flat unlimited plan)

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Catch-all / unknown results still require judgment even with deep verification claims

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: ESP comparison criteria (creation/automation) do not apply — adjacent hygiene tool

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Bouncer plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Email Verification — 1,000 credits

blocks.title: Validate email-marketing fit before a deep Bouncer rollout
blocks.body: If Bouncer fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Bouncer object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate InboxAlly before sunk-cost expansion
